lo.note:
A single character has sparsity $1$ and $\mathrm{osss} = 1$: the two agree, but neither
grows, so this witnesses no exponent. No function in the zoo has $\mathrm{osss}$ growing
while $\mathrm{spar}$ stays bounded -- indeed $\mathrm{spar}(f) = O(1)$ forces $f$ to be a
constant-size combination of characters, and $\mathrm{osss}$ is then bounded too.
